name: Spectre Necromancer
summary: Necromancer with a specific spectre: four Slave Drivers from the Templar Courts. The spectres do the damage, the gear is the same caster shell as the skeleton build, and no unique is required. A deliberately low-APM Dad build.

pros.text: The spectres keep attacking while you move; low APM and forgiving.
No required unique; gem levels and minion supports carry the damage.
The same caster gear as the skeleton and raging-spirit builds.
Slave Drivers are a known, easy-to-read spectre package.
A good Dad build: tanky minions and a simple rotation.
The spectre setup is portable between characters with the same links.

cons.text: You have to acquire and keep the specific spectres.
You are fragile when the minion wall breaks or you are caught alone.
Clear speed is slower than a bow build.
Spectre AI can spread damage away from the target you want.
Many gems compete for slots and links.
The first spectre setup needs a visit to the right zone.

summary.text: Spectre Necromancer is a low-APM minion build that measures 19.0k at red maps and 29.5k at pinnacle with four Slave Driver spectres. No unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with skeletons until Raise Spectre unlocks, then bring the Slave Drivers with you. The first checkpoint measures 344 life and 66 damage; the second measures 125.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 19.0k damage, 29949 effective life and 13498 physical max hit. Keep the spectres between you and the pack, cap the elemental resistances, and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 29.5k damage with 34315 effective life and 13194 physical max hit. Refresh the spectres before the burst and keep Flesh Offering up.
